claim: Preview only the already supported raw CLI room rename Title edit. No new room type, native UI, physical effect, family, whole-file or SPS claim.

existing_source_basis.relationship: Unmodified already supported room rename positional arguments and save-as option; no RoomMove variant is invented.

Authoritative existing rename: initial require_one, first unfiltered find_elements match, U defaulting to empty, uuid: lookup through set_attribute, unconditional text report before save, overwrite and conditional Document stamp.

Unmodified general selector admission, bracket post-filtering, UUID mirror de-duplication, traversal and ordered missing/ambiguity errors. No room-only type restriction or exact-title preference is introduced.
Existing input parsing, raw attribute values and exact UUID/general title/gid/type/bracket selector matching are reused without new policy.
Original final UUID resolution, single Title insertion and report spelling, including absent versus empty Title. No new name guard, normalization or no-op shortcut.
Existing room helpers are not the rename selector. find_room_uuid and add_room policies are deliberately not borrowed. Add/move operations are unchanged.
Unchanged normal serialization/default/BOM/CRLF and Document stamp behavior, never called by the preview branch.
Fail-closed global dispatch currently rejects room rename. Only ConfigCmd::Room(RoomCmd::Rename) is newly admitted.
Prior immutable-plan, raw-attribute, output-format and early-return conventions only; no splice or native semantics are imported.

hash_basis: SHA256 and Git blob OIDs above describe exact committed baseline LF blobs, not CRLF working-tree bytes.
provenance_boundary: The existing repository CLI implementation is the sole behavior source. No native caller, family, whole-file, SPS or physical-effect promotion; no new native execution, corpus extraction, lab or SDK evidence.

shared_plan.existing_api: CLI grammar and normal output unchanged; ConfigEditor::set_attribute unchanged.
shared_plan.application: One immutable plan resolves initial admitted selection, first unfiltered UUID source, actual final UUID target, raw before/after Title, attribute-only changed status and exact legacy report. Writer inserts Title directly at that planned path, without re-resolution. Preview never applies the plan or clones a DOM.
shared_plan.no_new_support: No room-only type guard, new room/name policy, trimming, ASCII restriction, normalization, duplicate-name rejection, selector correction, mirror propagation, reference rewrite or generic mutation framework.

preserved_semantics: Initial require_one(selector) errors precede all later lookups. find_room_uuid is not used. Exact titles do not override substring ambiguity.

The first unfiltered find_elements(selector) match supplies U, defaulting to empty, even when bracket filtering admitted a different element. The existing unreachable Room-not-found check is retained.

require_one(uuid:U) then chooses the final target with its existing case-sensitive UUID comparison and mirror de-duplication. Missing U can fail uuid: or resolve an existing empty-U element; no new guard is added.
The operation can target non-Place and unknown types, as before. Empty, whitespace, duplicate and Unicode names are accepted verbatim. Missing Title differs from present empty Title.
Only final target Title is inserted/replaced, including attribute order. All IoData, room references, UUIDs, other attributes, nested metadata and later mirrors remain unchanged by the edit.
Raw before/after values and all three identities/paths are visible; changed compares only Title presence/value and is not a promise of byte-level or native equivalence.
Writer text report remains unconditional and identical with table, JSON, CSV, quiet, no-header and trace flags. It is emitted before save/destination errors.
Normal save remains unconditional, overwrites existing destinations, preserves BOM/CRLF and stamps only when normalized content_changed says so. A true Title no-op saves without bumping the stamp.
preview_boundary: Read/parse/plan and diagnostic output only. Return precedes DOM mutation, serialization, default insertion, Document stamp, save, destination probing or directory/cache/network/telemetry writes, including input/existing/new/missing-parent save-as, no-op and failure paths. JSON adds dry_run and optional trace_id; table/CSV use JSON-valued cells. Quiet suppresses only table summary; no-header affects table/CSV headings.
tests: src/config_edit/rooms.rs::room_rename_tests: differential comparison against the exact former handler plus unchanged set_attribute; admitted selector/name variants, raw spelling, absence/empty/no-op, non-room/unknown types, mirrors, bracket first-match behavior, second UUID lookup, ordered errors, complete DOM equivalence and BOM/CRLF.

tests/dry_run.rs::room_rename_preview_reports_raw_titles_identity_and_all_formats_without_writes: actual selection/path/raw attributes, JSON/trace/quiet/no-header and table/CSV output with raw Unicode/quotes/commas.

tests/dry_run.rs::room_rename_preview_preserves_all_destinations_and_ordered_failures: full sandbox contents/mtime/permissions snapshots with telemetry locally enabled and local network observer; input/existing/new/missing-parent destinations, no-op/admitted/non-room/missing/ambiguous/malformed inputs and unchanged fail-closed add/move.

tests/dry_run.rs::room_rename_normal_writer_preserves_report_save_overwrite_noop_and_stamp: unchanged text output even with JSON/CSV/quiet, overwrite/report-before-error, source preservation, BOM/CRLF, references/IDs/metadata, unconditional no-op save and conditional stamp.
